title: Grenade fragments
summary: A grenade went off next to a rifleman. He is awake with fragment wounds to the left arm, right leg and torso, and his left arm looks deformed.
objectives: Find every wound: fragments spread over several limbs
Stop the bleeding (tourniquet if a limb bleeds heavily, pressure bandages for the rest)
Seal a torso fragment wound if the chest is injured
Patient alive and not bleeding at handover
